theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ci_unramified_subfield
theorems.statement: ∀ (E D : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ D] (q : ℕ), q.Prime → D ≤ E → (∀ P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), P.IsPrime → P.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → Ideal.ramificationIdx P ℤ = 1) → ∀ R : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers D), R.IsPrime → R.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}) → Ideal.ramificationIdx R ℤ = 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
